description: Sets or clears a client's load target on one exercise, and sets their insight mode and daily protein target. Use when the user wants to prescribe a weight for a client, remove that prescription, or change how a client's insights are framed. Not for editing a workout's prescribed weights for everyone (use update_workout). Returns the saved values. Overwrites the previous target or setting; insight settings need client insights in the team plan.

clear_target.description: true = remove the coach-set target for exercise_id. Don't combine with weight.

client_id.description: ID of the client (their user ID). Get it from list_clients (the "id" of each client), e.g. "64f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1".

exercise_id.description: ID of the exercise to set or clear a load target for, 24 hex characters. Get it from list_team_exercises or get_client_session, e.g. "64f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1".

insight_mode.description: Lens for this client's insights: auto = clear the override and use the team default; coach = strength and training; physio = rehab and pain; weight_management = weight and nutrition; wellness = general health habits.

protein_target_g.description: Daily protein target in grams, 30 to 400, e.g. 120. null clears it.

reps.description: Target reps at that load, 1 to 100. Optional.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

weight.description: Target load for exercise_id, 0.5 to 1000, in weight_unit. Overrides the workout's weight and the suggestion until cleared.

weight_unit.description: Unit of weight: metric = kg; imperial = lb. Required with weight.

name: set_client_coaching
title: Set client coaching targets
